answer: One concrete defense is a per-epoch liveness pulse. Each identity bonds non-refundable stake and must answer a randomly timed, hardware-signed pulse inside a narrow window. Standing bends like a willow toward peers who answer consistently; miss the pulse and your reputation enters a slashing spiral that forfeits the bond. One machine sustains one live pulse, so N fakes demand N separate bonded machines online at once every epoch: linear N times the hardware, power, and locked capital, never amortized across clones.
